_comment: Bannerlord Coop (unofficial) egg. Built by tools/build_egg.py; edit egg-source/ and runtime/, not this file.
name: Bannerlord Coop Dedicated Server (Unofficial)
author: vona@example.invalid
description: Dedicated server for the Bannerlord Coop mod (CoopNightly) for Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord, run under Wine. The server and any Workshop mods are downloaded with your own Steam account that owns Bannerlord. Unofficial, and not affiliated with Bannerlord Coop LLC or TaleWorlds. Read and accept the Coop EULA before use.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server

echo "Installing SteamCMD..."
mkdir -p steamcmd
curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd

echo "Installing the egg's start-up programs into coop-egg/..."
rm -rf coop-egg
mkdir -p coop-egg
base64 -d <<'PAYLOAD' | tar -xz -C coop-egg



















PAYLOAD

mkdir -p logs addons
echo "Done. Start the server to download Coop (about 6 GB)."

variables.name: Steam account
variables.description: Name of a Steam account that owns Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord. It is used to download the Coop server and the Workshop mods. It is never written to the logs.

variables.name: Steam password
variables.description: Password for the Steam account. The Panel does not mask this field, and every admin of the Panel can read it. If Steam asks for a Steam Guard code on the first start, type it into the Panel console.

variables.name: Accept Coop EULA
variables.description: Set to 1 to accept the Bannerlord Coop EULA and licence. The server refuses to start until you do. After the first download you can read DedicatedServer/EULA.md and DedicatedServer/LICENSE.txt in the Files tab. Paid hosting needs written permission from Bannerlord Coop LLC.

variables.name: Workshop mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop item IDs of mods to run, separated by commas, for example 2859188632,2859232415. Leave empty for a plain Coop server. Players need the same mods. The list, with names and links, is saved to modlist.txt.

variables.name: Join password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: World save name
variables.description: Name of the campaign save to host (without .sav). A new world is created if it does not exist. To host a save from your own PC, upload it to the Game Saves folder described in the README and enter its name here.

variables.name: Autosave interval (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes between saves. 0 = off. Default: 5.

variables.name: Write log file
variables.description: Coop writes its own log file. Default: on.

variables.name: Damage players take
variables.description: Damage players take. Default: VeryEasy.

variables.name: Damage player troops take
variables.description: Damage player troops take. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Combat AI difficulty
variables.description: Enemy battle AI. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Recruitment difficulty
variables.description: Recruiting troops. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Player map movement speed
variables.description: Map speed. Default: VeryEasy.

variables.name: Stealth and disguise difficulty
variables.description: Sneaking and disguises. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Persuasion success chance
variables.description: Persuasion odds. Default: VeryEasy.

variables.name: Clan member death chance
variables.description: Clan member deaths. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Battle death
variables.description: Hero deaths in battle. Default: Easy.

variables.name: Aging, births and deaths
variables.description: Aging, births and natural deaths. Default: off.

variables.name: Auto-allocate clan member perks
variables.description: Picks clan member perks for you. Default: off.

variables.name: Fast forward
variables.description: Allow 2x speed. Default: on.

variables.name: Auto pause
variables.description: Pause when all players are busy. Default: on.

variables.name: Clients can cheat
variables.description: Players can use cheats. Default: off.

variables.name: Income in settlements
variables.description: Gold, food and influence change in settlements. Default: off.

variables.name: Income in battles
variables.description: Disabled, OneDayMax or Enabled. Default: OneDayMax.

variables.name: Income for offline players
variables.description: Offline players still gain or lose gold and food. Default: off.

variables.name: AI battle join window
variables.description: Hours AI can join a player battle. 0 = never. Default: 24.

variables.name: Speed limit in battle
variables.description: Lock to 1x speed during player battles. Default: on.

variables.name: Wanderer limit
variables.description: Max wanderers and companions. Default: 32.

variables.name: Wanderer limit scales
variables.description: Wanderer limit grows with players. Default: off.

variables.name: Clan tier for a kingdom
variables.description: Clan tier needed to found a kingdom. Default: 4.

variables.name: Smithing recovery on the map
variables.description: Smithing stamina recovers while travelling. Default: off.

variables.name: Smithing recovery speed
variables.description: Stamina recovery multiplier. Vanilla is 1. Default: 0.1.

variables.name: Looter multiplier
variables.description: Looter party count. High values lag. Default: 1.0.

variables.name: Lord defection retries
variables.description: Vanilla, NeverExpire or AlwaysRetry. Default: Vanilla.

variables.name: Hero executions
variables.description: Players can execute AI heroes. Default: on.

variables.name: Execute players' clan members
variables.description: Players can execute each other's clan members. Default: off.
